summary.title: A Small Home WLAN
summary.description:
. A Small Home WLAN with 1 Router, 2 laptops used by the parents, 2 smartphones used by their 2 sons and a printer. All traffic passes through one combined router/access point (AP) supplied by the ISP which is MTN.
• One Wi-Fi network, WPA2-Personal, PSK
• 2 laptops, 2 smartphones, 1 printer
• Router admin page still on default credentials
• Guests use the same Wi-Fi as the children; no VLANs, no guest network
